name: Sample office message arrives in the shared Inbox
description: Inbox works in the sample household and a scripted office message lands in it.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /demo in a fresh browser context and wait until the page heading 'Today' is shown
Verify no warning about email setup waiting for capacity or a mailbox limit is shown
Open 'Sample controls' and click 'Receive office message'
Open 'Inbox' and choose the 'New' or 'All' view
Verify a conversation from the sample office is listed
Verify the message body contains 'SYNTHETIC DEMO'
